front_blocks.md: **True or False?**
A plant cell in a concentrated sugar solution will become turgid.

back_blocks.md: **False.**
Water moves **out** of the cell, so it becomes **plasmolysed** (flaccid), not turgid.

cards.back_md:

front_blocks.md: What happens to an **animal cell** (e.g. red blood cell) in a solution with a **higher water potential** (pure water)?

back_blocks.md: Water moves **into** the cell by osmosis.
The cell **swells and bursts** (lysis).

cards.front_md: What happens to an **animal cell** (e.g. red blood cell) in a solution with a **higher water potential** (pure water)?
cards.back_md:
Water moves **into** the cell by osmosis.

The cell **swells and bursts** (lysis).

front_blocks.md: Define **lysis**.

back_blocks.md: **Lysis** is the **bursting** of an animal cell when too much water enters it by osmosis and the cell membrane breaks.

cards.front_md: Define **lysis**.
cards.back_md: **Lysis** is the **bursting** of an animal cell when too much water enters it by osmosis and the cell membrane breaks.

front_blocks.md: Why does an animal cell **burst** in pure water but a plant cell does not?

back_blocks.md: Animal cells have **no cell wall** to resist expansion.
Plant cells have a strong **cell wall** that prevents bursting.

cards.front_md: Why does an animal cell **burst** in pure water but a plant cell does not?
cards.back_md:
Animal cells have **no cell wall** to resist expansion.

Plant cells have a strong **cell wall** that prevents bursting.

front_blocks.md: What happens to a **red blood cell** in a solution with a **lower water potential** (concentrated)?

back_blocks.md: Water moves **out** of the cell by osmosis.
The cell **shrinks** and shrivels (crenation).

cards.front_md: What happens to a **red blood cell** in a solution with a **lower water potential** (concentrated)?
cards.back_md:
Water moves **out** of the cell by osmosis.

The cell **shrinks** and shrivels (crenation).

front_blocks.md: Define **crenation**.

back_blocks.md: **Crenation** is the **shrinking and shrivelling** of an animal cell when water leaves it by osmosis into a more concentrated solution.

cards.front_md: Define **crenation**.
cards.back_md: **Crenation** is the **shrinking and shrivelling** of an animal cell when water leaves it by osmosis into a more concentrated solution.

front_blocks.md: An animal cell placed in pure water will swell and <u>   </u>.

back_blocks.md: An animal cell placed in pure water will swell and **burst**.

front_blocks.md: **True or False?**
Animal cells can burst in pure water because they have no cell wall.

back_blocks.md: **True.**
With **no cell wall** to resist expansion, water entering by osmosis makes the cell **swell and burst**.

cards.front_md:
**True or False?**

Animal cells can burst in pure water because they have no cell wall.
cards.back_md:
**True.**

With **no cell wall** to resist expansion, water entering by osmosis makes the cell **swell and burst**.

front_blocks.md: Why do plant and animal cells respond **differently** to being placed in pure water?

back_blocks.md: **Plant cells** have a **cell wall** that stops them bursting, so they become **turgid**.
**Animal cells** have **no cell wall**, so they **burst (lyse)**.

cards.front_md: Why do plant and animal cells respond **differently** to being placed in pure water?
cards.back_md:
**Plant cells** have a **cell wall** that stops them bursting, so they become **turgid**.

**Animal cells** have **no cell wall**, so they **burst (lyse)**.

front_blocks.md: Compare what happens to a plant cell and an animal cell in a **concentrated** (low water potential) solution.

back_blocks.md: **Plant cell:** water leaves and the cell becomes **plasmolysed** (membrane pulls from the wall).
**Animal cell:** water leaves and the cell **shrinks (crenates)**.

cards.front_md: Compare what happens to a plant cell and an animal cell in a **concentrated** (low water potential) solution.
cards.back_md:
**Plant cell:** water leaves and the cell becomes **plasmolysed** (membrane pulls from the wall).

**Animal cell:** water leaves and the cell **shrinks (crenates)**.

front_blocks.md: What terms describe a plant cell and an animal cell that have **gained** water in pure water?

back_blocks.md: **Plant cell** = **turgid** (firm).
**Animal cell** = **lysed** (burst).

back_blocks.md: In a concentrated solution a plant cell becomes plasmolysed, while an animal cell becomes **crenated**.

front_blocks.md: **True or False?**
Both plant and animal cells burst when placed in pure water.

back_blocks.md: **False.**
**Animal** cells burst, but **plant** cells do **not** — their **cell wall** stops them bursting, so they become **turgid**.
